query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "cnt!"
           FROM playback_states ps JOIN items i ON i.id = ps."itemId"
           WHERE ps."userId" = $1 AND ps."playedAt" IS NOT NULL
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media mAcl WHERE mAcl.id = i."mediaId" AND mAcl."libraryId" = ANY($2)
                         AND mAcl.type = ANY($3))
